verdict.rationale: Bolt lets you start from something other than a blank prompt: you can import an existing GitHub repository or a Lovable project, bring in Figma or Google Stitch designs, or upload files. Bolt Slides also offers default slide layouts and the Prompt Library has built-in prompts, which work like lightweight templates. Missing for 10: a documented template gallery, community project browsing or remixing (forking), and independent hands-on corroboration of starting from templates.
